geography.method: Exact published Hawaii and Honolulu county text in state HI resolves uniquely to active registry FIPS 15001 and 15003. Publisher assigned county using 2020 TIGER/Line; no independent coordinate routing.
geography.coordinatePolicy: No coordinates used, inferred, recovered or rerouted. No automatic retired-county successor mapping.

taxonomy.method: Program-specific positive varroa_per_100_bees metric interpreted as Varroa destructor under the hash-pinned independent source reviews and APHIS 2016-2017 report page 4. Individual CSV rows contain the metric name, not a literal binomial; the 2025 plan uses Varroa spp.

stableIdentityFields: original compressed and decoded CSV SHA-256
parsedRowIndexZeroBased including dictionary row at zero

limitations: This positive-only method makes no negative claim. Forty-one zero measurements and four blank measurements in the selected counties are retained and grouped as excluded rows.
A complete selected-pair snapshot screen does not establish countywide absence, source exhaustiveness, protocol completion, local acquisition, wild establishment or current persistence.

caveats: Composite apiary samples pool eight managed honey bee colonies; a positive result does not mean all eight colonies were infested.
The parasite was detected in a managed-host sampling context. Wild establishment, local acquisition, countywide prevalence and persistence today are not established.
Migratory and stationary operations participated; individual public rows do not disclose migration history or apiary identifiers.
The metric is mites per 100 bees, not a raw mite count. No sample denominator is available to reconstruct a raw count.
The CSV metric is mapped at program level to Varroa destructor using the official 2016-2017 report; raw rows do not literally name the species. The 2025 plan uses Varroa spp. wording.
Publisher county text comes from its 2020 TIGER/Line assignment; no coordinates or automatic retired-county successor assignment are used here.
Collection month precision is preserved. Export, acquisition and review timestamps are separate.
Zero, blank, invalid, ambiguous and held records create no positive or negative claim. A completed selected source screen does not certify a county or complete its research protocol.
Anonymous rows are retained by immutable archive and exact row locator. Similar or identical disclosed fields cannot prove that two sampling events are identical.
